title: Stationary-wave experiments
design_rationale: Transfer the stationary-wave model into the three required experimental systems while keeping end corrections outside scope.
concepts_taught: show an understanding of experiments that demonstrate stationary waves using microwaves, stretched strings and air columns (it will be assumed that end corrections are negligible; knowledge of the concept of end corrections is not required)

next_module_can_assume: show an understanding of experiments that demonstrate stationary waves using microwaves, stretched strings and air columns (it will be assumed that end corrections are negligible; knowledge of the concept of end corrections is not required)
next_module_must_not_assume: explain the meaning of the term diffraction
